new='''def transform(grid):
    """Shift all non-background cells down by one row."""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = max((len(row) for row in grid), default=0)
    if not rows or not cols:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    out = [[background for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for r in range(rows - 1):
        for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if value != background:
                out[r + 1][c] = value
    return out
'''
